Is your favourite armchair sagging in the middle? Is the sofa you inherited too good to throw out but too shabby to sit on? – [1] –. At Verdigris Studio we bring tired chairs, sofas, and headboards back to life. We believe that living with furniture you love makes a home calmer and far more welcoming. Our team works with you to strip, repair, and re-cover your pieces properly.

Click here to see before-and-after photographs of a client’s reading chair. What was a faded, sagging seat is now a firm, bright piece finished with a set of removable, washable covers. The new covers make it easy to keep the chair clean and, more importantly, to change its look later without any further work. – [2] –.

We handle everything from a single-chair refresh to a whole-room renovation. We can also make custom cushion sets to match your design. – [3] –. If you are not sure where to start, our team can carry out an assessment in your home. To schedule an appointment, simply choose a date and time on our “BOOKINGS” page. – [4] –.
